$description: Levves type. Serif for titles and numbers, sans for everything you read or press.

serif.$description: Window titles, headings, readouts and every number that's read (amounts, dates, timers)

sans.$description: Body text, rows, fields, and the caps labels

semibold.$description: Titles, caps labels, keys, the name in a row

label.$description: Caps labels: group headers, column headers, status bars

body-touch.$description: Phone body text and fields (iOS zooms into fields under 16px)

number.$description: Serif numbers inline with body text

heading.$description: A screen's heading on the phone

readout.$description: A number in a readout well

readout-large.$description: The one big number of a screen

label.$description: Caps labels and key labels, always uppercase
